pages.text: Custom Girls are special girls that can be added through JSON configurations and resource packs. They allow for completely customizable appearances, behaviors, and interactions.$(br2)These girls are loaded from $(o)girls.json$() files and can have unique models, textures, sounds, and scene configurations.

$(o)Spawning:$()$(br)Craft a $(item)Custom Girl Spawn Egg$() then fuse it at the $(item)Fusion Table$() with two identical tame items to create a specialized spawn egg. Right-click to spawn the girl.$(br2)$(o)Custom Girl Installation:$()$(br)- Install the $(o)(girl name).json$() file into $(o)\config\Heartbound\girls\$()$(br)- Install and enable the resource pack$(br2)$(o)Tame Item$() - Configurable per girl$(br)$(o)Scenes$() - Fully customizable
